name: Tool Gossip
summary: Site where people log the tools they start, quit and swear by and see what people with a similar stack use.
description: Tool Gossip is a community site for sharing and browsing developer tool stacks; this URL is a tool post for Replit (post 1092). The page body renders client-side, so only the site title and description were readable.
